BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill is a road group ride in Cincinnati, OH. It meets every Monday, 6:00 pm, starting at BioWheels Workshop. Expect about 27.5 miles, B group 17–19 mph, C group 14–16 mph.

About the BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill group ride

A shop ride into Indian Hill with two hills and regroups at the top. Two speed groups led by volunteers. Route changes weekly.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
